intent.raw: Create a research strategy so we can get all work done in tagging and indexing sense in domainspec-core whole repository.
intent.objective: Plan a governed multi-lane research route for repository-wide tagging and indexing of /home/vrondelli/projects/domainspec-core without flattening authority boundaries, duplicating existing inventory, or promoting candidate knowledge as canonical.
intent.operator_sentence: Use dispatch-spec to plan the whole-repository tagging and indexing research, then gate execution before Inventory ingest/backfill work starts.

route_menu.context_hint: The repository is multi-zone and already contains generated state, source packages, implementation projects, research corpora, and prior Arcanum inventory work.

items.label: Zone-first fanout
items.description: Map repository zones, knowledge surfaces, tag taxonomy, indexing shape, and pilot slices in parallel before synthesis.

items.label: Single-thread scan
items.description: Build one parent-thread scan of top-level folders before any delegated investigation.

items.label: Pilot slice first
items.description: Choose one high-value slice and use it to derive repository-wide tag/index rules afterward.

technique_overlays.trigger: Repository-wide tagging and indexing may accidentally promote candidate knowledge or duplicate existing authority surfaces.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The route must separate source indexing from ontology, definitions, lifecycle, runtime, and deletion authority.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Whole-repository tagging and indexing spans independent authority zones and artifact classes.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Parallel lane research is useful because zone authority, knowledge surfaces, tags, indexing shape, and pilot-slice selection can be investigated independently, then joined by parent synthesis.
context: domainspec-core contains Arcanum, sigils-library, implementation projects, Lean formalization, cyberAlchemy, docs, research, ops, tools, validation, and local/generated state.
Inventory already has a whole-Arcanum method, but the parent repository needs a broader zone and tag/index strategy.
Generated or local runtime state must not become source authority by accident.

roles.purpose: Classify repository zones, source/runtime/generated boundaries, and ownership ambiguity.
Find existing indexes, docs, registries, inventories, glossaries, ontology files, and work-pack evidence before new inventory work is proposed.
Design bounded tag families for lookup, routing, authority, status, source class, handoff, and risk.
Design repository-level, zone-level, slice-level, evidence-card, and retrieval-fixture indexes.
Choose candidate first slices with retrieval questions, source anchors, validation needs, and stop conditions.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve running the repository tagging/indexing fanout research lanes over /home/vrondelli/projects/domainspec-core?
receipt_requirements: Each lane returns concrete path evidence.
Each lane names exclusions and unresolved residue.
Each lane states whether it found promotion or duplicate-inventory risk.

steps.name: Recover parent repository frame
stop_conditions: Block if the repository root cannot be inspected.
Flag if prior Inventory surfaces cannot be distinguished from generated runtime state.

steps.name: Run repository tagging and indexing research lanes
convergence_criteria: Every lane cites concrete paths or selector candidates from /home/vrondelli/projects/domainspec-core.
Every lane names source exclusions and unresolved residue.
Every lane distinguishes Inventory-owned evidence/index work from downstream promotion authority.
The pilot backlog contains task-shaped slices rather than whole-folder summaries.
stop_conditions: Block synthesis if a lane cannot classify generated/local state.
Block if an output claims ontology, definitions, lifecycle, deletion, or runtime promotion authority.
Ask the operator before executing subagents.

steps.name: Synthesize repository tagging and indexing plan
convergence_criteria: The synthesis identifies the first three inventory slices by expected retrieval value.
The synthesis includes tag taxonomy and indexing shape decisions or explicitly routes unresolved decisions to a gate.
The synthesis records duplicate inventory and authority-conflict risks.
stop_conditions: Route to decision-gate if Arcanum and sigils-library authority is ambiguous.
Route to definitions-governance if tag vocabulary becomes canonical definition work.
Route to ontology-vault if relation promotion is requested.

steps.name: Gate first Inventory ingest or backfill slice
convergence_criteria: Select one first slice or block with a reason.
Record why other candidate slices are deferred.
Name the exact source anchors and expected inventory outputs before mutation.
stop_conditions: Ask the operator before any ingest or backfill mutation.
Block if the selected slice lacks a retrieval question.

gates.condition: Research outputs must cite concrete paths or selector candidates, not only zone labels.
Inventory execution must use task-shaped slices and must not ingest the whole repository as one summary.

Research and Inventory outputs may propose candidate evidence, tags, indexes, and handoffs but must not promote ontology, definitions, sigil lifecycle, spell lifecycle, deletion, or runtime authority.
The operator approves delegated fanout research before subagents run.
The operator confirms the first slice target before Inventory ingest/backfill mutates files.

boundaries.contract: Repository source files are read-only inputs during research. Mutation is limited to the Inventory development strategy package until a later approved task-session.
.arcanum, .codex, .agents, .data, and generated outputs are excluded by default unless promoted by durable source evidence.
Inventory may expose evidence and candidate handoffs but cannot promote ontology, definitions, sigil lifecycle, spell lifecycle, deletion, or runtime authority.

authority.promotion: downstream owners only: ontology-vault, definitions-governance, sigil-development, spellcraft, or repository governance as applicable

state_namespaces.write_policy: Strategy, research, synthesis, and handoff artifacts may be written here during approved Inventory planning work.
Read-only during this research route unless a later approved install/sync task explicitly targets runtime state.

promotion_splits.rule: Tags are lookup aids only until Definitions Governance explicitly promotes canonical vocabulary.
Evidence cards may provide candidate relation evidence but cannot promote ontology relations.
Research may flag cleanup candidates but cannot authorize moves, deletions, or source authority changes.

promotion_guardrails: Do not promote candidate tags into canonical definitions.
Do not promote candidate evidence relations into Ontology Vault.
Do not treat runtime/generated state as canonical source.
Do not resolve Arcanum versus sigils-library source authority without a decision gate.
Do not execute Inventory ingest/backfill until the operator confirms the first slice.
